explanation: Around 1920 the British Empire covered about a quarter of the world's land. The Mongol Empire, at about 24 million km², was the largest whose lands all joined up.

claims.text: At its height, around 1920, the British Empire covered about 35.5 million km².
At its height, in the 1270s, the Mongol Empire covered about 24 million km².
Around 1920 the British Empire covered about a quarter of the world's land area.
The Mongol Empire was the largest contiguous land empire in history.
